## Where it fits

Check what applies — and read the relevant rules in
[`README.md`](https://github.com/pulsearc-ai/ReadySet/blob/main/README.md):

- [ ] New built-in. (Has to clear the Built-in vs. plugin bar.)
- [ ] New first-party provider plugin.
- [ ] New capability id on an existing provider.
- [ ] Change to the dispatcher↔plugin contract (env vars, manifest,
      describe, capability shapes, change log, exit codes,
      `.ready-set.toml`).
- [ ] SDK API addition.
- [ ] Documentation / wiki.
- [ ] Other.
